## Change summary

<!-- Describe the behavior and owning app/source. -->

## Release and deployment scope

- [ ] Exact site, bench, app branch and source/target hashes recorded.
- [ ] Related open PRs and overlapping patches checked.
- [ ] Migration/fixture/Server Script writers and repeatability reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets, backups, customer data or employee data added.

## Permissions and acceptance

- [ ] Affected DocTypes, fields/permlevels, reports, pages, workspaces and linked records listed.
- [ ] Standard/custom matrices, roles/profiles, User Permissions, hooks and later writers reviewed.
- [ ] Intended audiences and allowed/denied operations declared.
- [ ] Before/after access evidence captured; additions and removals reviewed.
- [ ] Fresh-session linked-record workflow completed for each affected audience.
- [ ] PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED recorded; remaining NOT TESTED gates are clearly open.
- [ ] Backup/recovery and post-deploy read-back recorded.

Use [Final release checklist](../docs/FINAL_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md). A successful build or Administrator view is not user acceptance.
